# plan: m42-forms-cells

- [x] t1 Leave an inline cell, the filter bar, the search palette and a belongsTo picker alone on an Enter that confirms an IME composition
- [x] t2 Post a file action through the shared request, so a password check asks and replays the file, and a 401 or 419 asks to sign in
- [x] t3 Disable a form's Save while a file uploads, reading "Uploading…", refuse Enter's submit meanwhile, and enable it again when an upload fails
- [x] t4 Keep the last file picked when an earlier upload ends later, and give each pasted editor image its own upload  [after: t3]
- [ ] t5 Merge a lens's edited cell into the cells it already shows, in the row and the preview panel
- [ ] t6 Save one record's inline cells in turn, each sending the token the one before got back, in lists, lenses and relation tables  [after: t5]
- [ ] t7 Keep the all-matching selection when a Shift-click range ticks rows
- [ ] t8 Keep a dependent field's newest lookup when an older one answers late
- [ ] t9 Retry a failed save with the values the form holds now, and keep a passed save's toast when only its refresh failed  [after: t3]
- [ ] t10 Stop the import dialog's poll once it closes, and on a 404, 401 or 403 with an error
- [ ] t11 Toast a flash message once, not again on a partial reload of the same page
